name: av_unc_with_integral
source:
{ Uncertainty alongside an Integral — the extraction happens BEFORE
  findIntegrals, so the declaration must not reach the quadrature driver. }
c = 2
UncertaintyOf(c) = 0.05
F = Integral(c*tt^2, tt, 0, 3)
uF = UncertaintyOf(F)
